label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (path-injection) is a True Positive. User input ('BenchmarkTest') is retrieved into 'param' (L13) and directly concatenated into the redirect URL at L22 ('https://cdn.safe.com' + param). While a prefix check against an init-parameter ('allowed') exists (L17-18), 'startsWith' is an insufficient mitigation for redirect validation as it permits arbitrary data following the allowed prefix (e.g., subdomain injection or path traversal). The resolved sink value depends on attacker-controlled input.

evidence.note: Sink: sendRedirect uses param directly in URL construction
